numerical_failure.expected_behavior: crystalball.sf(x, beta, m) should keep precision for large x. For x > -beta the survival function is a multiple of the normal survival function: _norm_pdf_C*_norm_sf(x)/M, where M = m/beta/(m-1)*exp(-beta**2/2) + _norm_pdf_C*_norm_cdf(beta).
trigger_conditions: x > -beta uses the Gaussian tail formula after the fix; buggy path is 1 - cdf in the right tail
